source.derivation: The signed-off Workbench rubric v1.4 simplifies the active forehand workflow to four phases, introduces observation groups and observation-specific diagnostic scales, and preserves historical identifiers where their coaching meaning remains stable.

ready_position.label: Ready Position
ready_position.description: Assess the player's ready position immediately before initiating movement towards the shot.

max_take_back.label: Max Take Back
max_take_back.description: Assess the moment of maximum preparation immediately before the forward swing begins.

contact_point.label: Contact Point
contact_point.description: Assess the instant the player makes contact with the ball, or the best estimate where contact occurs.

max_follow_through.label: Max Follow Through
max_follow_through.description: Assess the point at which the follow-through reaches its maximum extent before recovery begins.

stance_width.label: Stance Width
stance_width.description: Assess whether the player's stance width is appropriate for the selected phase.

knee_bend.label: Knee Bend
knee_bend.description: Assess whether the player has an appropriate athletic base and knee flexion for the selected phase.

body_balance.label: Body Balance
body_balance.description: Assess whether the player looks balanced, stable and in control during the selected phase.

racket_side_preparation.label: Preparation Position
racket_side_preparation.description: Assess whether the arm and racket side are positioned appropriately for readiness.

racket_preparation_height.label: Preparation Height
racket_preparation_height.description: Assess whether the visible preparation height is appropriate for the ready position.

court_body_orientation.label: Court Body Orientation
court_body_orientation.description: Assess whether the player's body orientation relative to the court is appropriate for the selected phase.

shoulder_hip_separation.label: Shoulder / Hip Separation
shoulder_hip_separation.description: Assess whether the relationship between shoulder rotation and hip rotation looks appropriate for the selected phase.

non_hitting_arm_extension.label: Non-hitting Arm Extension
non_hitting_arm_extension.description: Assess the extension and structure of the non-hitting arm for the selected phase.

non_hitting_arm_orientation.label: Non-hitting Arm Orientation
non_hitting_arm_orientation.description: Assess whether the non-hitting arm points in an appropriate direction for the selected phase, independently of elbow extension.

hitting_arm_structure.label: Hitting-arm Compactness
hitting_arm_structure.description: Assess whether the hitting arm remains compact, controlled and well organised during preparation.

hitting_arm_orientation.label: Hitting-arm Orientation
hitting_arm_orientation.description: Assess whether the hitting arm is oriented appropriately during preparation.

elbow_position.label: Hitting-elbow Compactness
elbow_position.description: Assess whether the hitting elbow remains appropriately controlled relative to the body.

hitting_arm_extension.label: Hitting-arm Extension
hitting_arm_extension.description: Assess the extension and reach of the hitting arm for the selected phase.

contact_height.label: Contact Height
contact_height.description: Assess whether the apparent contact height is appropriate relative to the player's body position.

contact_distance.label: Contact Distance from Body
contact_distance.description: Assess whether the apparent contact point is appropriately spaced from the body.

contact_fore_aft_position.label: Contact Fore / Aft Position
contact_fore_aft_position.description: Assess whether apparent contact occurs at an appropriate fore/aft position relative to the player.

follow_through_height.label: Follow-through Height
follow_through_height.description: Assess whether the hitting wrist finishes at an appropriate height.

recovery_position.reason: Removed from the active Workbench profile; historical recovery_frame and phase assessment data remain preserved.

weight_transfer.reason: Not retained in the signed-off simplified observation set.

follow_through_shape.reason: Removed as redundant with hitting-elbow compactness, hitting-arm extension and follow-through height.
